title: docs(pm-dispatch): lanes are seats and epics; the domain seats retire and a lease only guards file overlap
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgAMcczttxyWbA2wxhwtweCG)_
Fixes #35232

Rule-change: yes
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:用户无感;车队的派工说明改成「座位加专题」:按代码域设的五个座位不再出现,座位按您点名的产品专题和子专题取卡,分区租约只用来防两个开发同时改同一批文件。
- 为什么做:这是「车队技能评审」整改顺序里「车道改为座位加专题」这一步的文字部分,让说明和现在实际的取卡方式一致。
- 出错会怎样:某句改错的话,座位可能去找已经不存在的域座位,或误以为分区决定取哪张卡;把这次合并整体撤回就恢复原文,脚本行为没有改动。
- 要你做什么:契约复核通过后,批准这次规则文字改动。

## Rule source

- The maintainer's 「同意」 (2026-11-18 16:19Z) to the fleet skills review and its order of improvements, as recorded in the body of the card this PR carries: "lanes become seats plus epics (text → scripts → lane files)". This PR is the text step.
- 「可以拆的都同意。」 (Warren, 2026-11-19 00:32Z), recorded in comment 6996519862 on the same card: the clean-up chain runs in parallel, and cards block each other only when they edit the same files.
- The card's own scope, verbatim: "Lanes become two kinds: **seats** and **epics**. The domain seats `server`, `spec`, `ui`, `devx` and `skills` retire. Area leases stay, but only to stop two developers editing the same files at once. A lease no longer decides which card a seat takes. Cards are picked by epic and area under the grade rules."

`Rule-change: yes` because the text changes what a seat does (how it picks a card, what a lease decides). The wording is this PR's, written to the ruled direction above; it is not a copy of an already ruled clause.

## What changes

Text only, in `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` and 16 files under `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/`. No script, agent definition, ADR or workflow is touched, and no lane file is moved, renamed or deleted.

### The model the text now states

`SKILL.md`, section 〈车道与域〉 (was 〈域车道〉), opens with two new lines and one extended line:

- A lane is one of two kinds: a seat or an epic (the subtree of an epic parent). The lane of a whole-repository seat is the areas and epics its seat post names.
- Cards are picked by area and epic under the grade rules (`references/execution-duties.md`). An area lease only guards two developers editing the same files; it does not decide which card is taken.
- The five domain seats (server, spec, ui, devx, skills) are retired. `domain:*` stays as the file-ownership label. Where a script still reads or prints `domain:*`, its behaviour is unchanged and the value reads as file ownership or as a former seat name.

### Rewritten lines, by file

- `SKILL.md`
  - Red line on triage and executing seats: an executing seat claims only in its lane and does not change `domain:*` (was: may change it when the whole tree is its own).
  - Entry table: the domain argument row (examples `spec`, `skills`) becomes a seat-word row (example `objectstack`).
  - 〈车道与域〉: the definition lines above; "`Seam:` cards belong to the spec seat" loses the seat; the `repo:objectstack` row says cards are claimed by the areas and epics on the seat post (was: by zone, seats split by lease).
  - 〈路径分叉〉: "the skills lane's own PRs" becomes "PRs of `domain:skills` cards", read by the seat that took the card.
  - Claim template: the `Seat:` line shows a repository seat or an epic seat (was a domain seat).
- The lane definition and its echoes (`SKILL.md` 〈车道与域〉 and the `repo:objectstack` row, `area-lease.md`, `execution-duties.md`, `lanes/objectstack.md`) say "the areas and epics the seat post names", without fixing a place on the post. `references/seat-post-protocol.md` says where: the title and the intake line of the description both carry the seat's `area:*` and epics, and the tools read the title (`seatIntakeKeys`). The two older sentences that told a seat to write a new area on the intake line only (`coordinator.md`, `lanes/objectstack.md`) now name the title too.
- `references/area-lease.md`: the zone definition now says a lease only stops two developers editing the same files and does not decide which card a seat takes; `Pre-claim lane:` names the `domain:*` of the paths as file ownership; the stay-in-lane line covers every domain's paths, since there is no domain seat to move a card to.
- `references/lanes/objectstack.md`: several seats split by the areas and epics on their seat posts, in place of the odd/even alternation (was: by zone lease); a lease does not hand out cards.
- `references/execution-duties.md`: the candidate read goes by the areas and epic subtrees the seat post names (was: by `domain:X` label); one new line beside the `card-pick.mjs` rule says the script still prints each row's `domain:*` and its lane-ownership footer, behaviour unchanged, read as file ownership; the clause-② line says the spec-lane sentence that `dispatch-gates.mjs --tier` still prints is residual script wording, that it no longer moves a card, and that build and review stay with the seat that took the card.
- `references/coordinator.md`: a card's lane is read from its area and epic parent (was: from `domain:*`); the coordinator "is not an executing seat" (was: "not a `domain:*` seat"); `lanes/director.md` says the director holds no executing lane (was: no `domain:*` lane).
- `references/project-forms.md`: the summon example no longer uses `ui skills`; the five domain reference files are not seat words.
- `references/cross-repo-coordination.md`, `references/seat-post-protocol.md`, `references/seat-lifecycle.md`, `references/lanes/director.md`: seat spellings and mentions that named a domain seat (`Seat: domain:X#N`, "域座位", "skills 车道", "skills 席", "`domain:*` 席") now name a seat without a domain.
- `references/lanes/{server,spec,ui,devx,skills}.md`: title and opening line only. Each file now says it is a domain reference, that the domain seat is retired, that 「本席」 in its body reads as the seat that took the card, and that the file waits for the lane-file reorganisation. Pointers to the renamed `SKILL.md` section are updated.

### Removed because the retired seats were their only subject

Each of these is a deletion a reviewer may want to weigh on its own:

1. The seat's own relabel right (席改标): two lines in `execution-duties.md`, its clause in the `SKILL.md` red line and in the `pm:retriage` row, the phrase in `cross-repo-coordination.md`, and the progress signal in `lanes/triage.md`. It let a domain seat rewrite `domain:*` when a card's remaining paths fell wholly in its package tree. `lanes/objectstack.md` already forbids a whole-repository seat to write `domain:*`; single-lane repositories never produce it.
2. The cross-domain exception path: two lines in `SKILL.md` 〈车道与域〉, its item in the out-of-lane channel list (five channels become four) and in the `pm:retriage` row. It had triage name one domain lane for a PR that crossed domains; a seat's lane no longer follows a domain.
3. "A clause-② card is the spec lane's work" in `execution-duties.md`. The rest of the clause-② rule (tier, review owed) is untouched.
4. In `landing-operations.md`, a `Part of` card's remainder is parked in `pm:queue`, blocked or on hold; the "plus its lane's `domain:*`, relabelled if it belongs to another lane" half is gone.

5. "An epic PM does not also hold a domain seat" in `seat-post-protocol.md`. The clause's only subject was the domain seat. It is deleted, not widened: the text does not say an epic PM may hold no other seat.
6. "Notify the other lane's online seat", the second half of the stay-in-lane line (`area-lease.md`, `lanes/objectstack.md`). There is no domain seat left to notify.

### Deliberately not changed

- "车道" as the general word for what a seat works on stays (about 230 occurrences); the new definition lines give it its meaning. "车道席" (15 occurrences) and "执行席" stay where they mean any seat on a lane.
- `references/contract-review.md` line 23, the `Contract-review-handoff:` template with its `domain:LANE#N` arm: `record-recognisers.mjs --self-test` reads that line verbatim from the file, so it changes with the script.
- `references/execution-duties.md` lines pinned by `card-pick.mjs` (`DUTIES_PHRASES`), including the pointer to `references/lanes/spec.md` for the contract-surface criteria: untouched.
- The bodies of the five domain reference files: they are reorganised by the lane-file step.
- The domain table itself (label to package family): it is the file-ownership map.

### Script behaviour: the card's premise, measured

The card says scripts still read `domain:*` until the script step. Measured at `origin/main` `ecbe854b`: the script step has already merged (PR #35587, 2026-11-19). `check-half-states.mjs` reads a seat's intake from its seat post (`seatIntakeKeys`: areas and epics) and its comments say the domain seats retired; `card-pick.mjs` rule 8 says a lease guards file overlap and is not read. What still reads or prints `domain:*`: the seat-signature and `Seat:` grammars accept `domain:X#N` beside `repo:` and `epic:`; `card-pick.mjs` prints each row's `domain:*` and a lane-ownership footer; the hand-off line accepts only an `l2-review` seat or a `domain:` seat as target; `dispatch-gates.mjs --tier` prints on every run "a hit outside the spec lane is spec-lane work and moves there" (and, on a suspect surface, a sentence placing the review in the spec lane). The text says behaviour is unchanged where it names these, and the clause-② line of `execution-duties.md` says how a seat reads the tier sentence.

## Tests

No test file changes: the diff is skill text.

- First head (`41289b4c`): `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derives 26 gate commands for this file list; all 26 were run and recorded with their exit codes, and `--ran` answers "26 derived, 26 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN". `check:doc-formula-expressions` exited 3 (prerequisite not met) on its first run because the workspace packages were not built, and 0 after `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/lint...' build` under the verify lock; the recorded code is the second run's.
- Review rework head (`84ffd7cf`, same 17 files, text only), the gates that read skill text re-run, all exit 0: `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` (every file at or under its ceiling; widest `SKILL.md` table row 341 of 341), `pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint`, `pnpm check:pm-record-recognisers`, `pnpm check:pm-label-write`, `pnpm check:pm-governed-prose`, `pnpm check:doc-authoring`, `pnpm check:nul-bytes`, `node scripts/pm/card-pick.mjs --self-test`, `node scripts/check-commit-card-trailers.mjs --range origin/main..HEAD`.
- The four-axis block is not touched (`pnpm check:skill-frame-sync` and `pnpm check:skill-frame-freshness` exit 0 on the first head).
- CI on the previous head `ef857400`: 48 check-runs, 23 success, 25 skipped, 0 failure.

## Acceptance notes

- Ceiling rows are not lowered. They live in `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`, outside this card's file surface. After this PR the ratchet prints these headrooms for the changed files: `SKILL.md` 8, `area-lease.md` 11 (5 of them already on `main`), `execution-duties.md` 10, `seat-post-protocol.md` 1, `coordinator.md` 4, `lanes/objectstack.md` 3, `lanes/director.md` 11, and for the other nine their delta in the table above (`lanes/ui.md` 0). The contract review answers that lowering is not owed here.
- Script-surface findings, not changed here, carried on #35237 comment 7181970862: `readContractReviewHandoff` in `scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs` reads a hand-off line addressed to `l2-review#1` or `domain:ui#2` and answers `unreadable` for `repo:objectstack#2` and for an epic seat, so the sibling-seat arm of the hand-off has no target a live seat can spell; the `card-pick.mjs` footer still words `domain:*` as lane ownership; one comment in the ratchet script names the old section title 〈域车道〉. The `--tier` spec-lane sentence listed under script behaviour belongs with them.
- `references/contract-review.md` line 23 still shows the `domain:` arm of the hand-off target, for the pin reason above; it changes with the script.
- `references/execution-duties.md` still carries lines written for domain seats that remain readable and harmless (the `ui/**` remainder lines, "他席树" in the partial-landing release line, the odd/even alternation for several seats on one lane). They are left for the lane-file step.
- Review rework (contract record 7181945119, seat check 7181956412): S1 the intake wording, S2 the tier sentence and S3 the epic PM clause are closed in `84ffd7cf` as described above.

## Verification

Read first, by risk:

1. `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md`, the red line on executing seats and the opening lines of 〈车道与域〉. The risk is a definition that is narrower or wider than the card's scope sentence.
2. `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md`, the two deleted relabel lines and the clause-② line, and `references/seat-post-protocol.md` line 18 and the deleted epic PM clause. The risk is a deletion that still had a live reader, or an intake sentence that disagrees with where the tools read.
3. `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/area-lease.md` lines 7, 34 and 47, and `references/lanes/objectstack.md` line 27. The risk is a lease sentence that still reads as a card-picking rule.

Two-minute check: `git grep -nE '域席|域座位|spec 席|skills 席|skills 车道|spec 车道' -- .claude/skills/pm-dispatch` prints eight lines: the seven retirement notices (one in `SKILL.md`, one in `area-lease.md`, one in the opening line of each of the five domain reference files) and the residual-wording clause on the clause-② line of `execution-duties.md`, and `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` exits 0 with every row at or under its ceiling.
